title: Donor-kernel trace diagnostic
assumptions: explicitly declared free-group map X=[[0,-1],[1,1]], Y=XZ
exact integer arithmetic, no floating point
output_meaning: Whether the first relator lies in ker rho, the second relator's SL(2,Z) trace, and the family parameter n implied by trace = -n(n+1)-2.
limits: Constrains the donor-kernel lane only. Not an unrestricted AC invariant: the legal two-move control [2,4] sends trace t to t^2-2.
